answer: Work waits on the wharf until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ivory of the next round. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Reaching the knoll of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
